import json, os
import psycopg

party='AMLP_E_2001X13'
url=os.getenv('APP_DB_URL','').strip()
with psycopg.connect(url) as conn:
  with conn.cursor() as cur:
    cur.execute("""
      select j.job_id, ji.item_key, ji.status, ji.error_text, ji.updated_at,
             coalesce(j.user_name,''), coalesce(j.user_id,''), ji.request_json, ji.response_json
      from job_items ji
      join jobs j on j.job_id=ji.job_id
      where ji.item_key=%s or ji.request_json ilike %s
      order by ji.updated_at desc
      limit 10
    """, (party, f'%{party}%'))
    rows=[]
    for r in cur.fetchall():
      rows.append({'job_id':r[0],'item_key':r[1],'status':r[2],'error_text':r[3],'updated_at':r[4],'user_name':r[5],'user_id':r[6],'request_json':r[7],'response_json':r[8]})
    print('PARTY_DETAIL', json.dumps(rows))
print('PARTY_DONE')
